summary: Verified all four Master Admin → Sicon Integration panel bugs are fixed. Backend pytest suite (6/6 passing) covers credential persistence + mask sentinel, /api/integrations/sicon/test-connection (with and without base_url), full 237-row /api/sicon/field-mapping payload, and integration_logs listing. Frontend Playwright walk-through logged in as master admin (with MFA via TOTP), opened /master-admin?section=sicon-integration and inspected every tab: Configuration shows the green 'Saved' credentials badge, saved base_url / username / company_id survived a reload, API Key field renders masked placeholder + 'Saved — leave blank to keep the current key.' hint; Test Connection button posts and renders a descriptive red 'Could not reach https://sicon-test.example.com: [Errno -2] Name or service not known' banner (expected in preview — no live Sicon); Field Mappings badge reads '237 fields' with 10 entity groups and all 237 rows rendered; Event Log rows expand to a full Event/Direction/Status/Time grid + Summary + Error/payload, never empty.
critical_code_review_comments: IntegrationAdminPanel.js is now ~800+ lines and heavily overloaded across Orbit4 + Sicon; consider splitting the Sicon-specific Configuration/Field Mapping blocks into a dedicated component to keep the file <700 lines.

The masked sentinel '••••••' is used as both display value AND keep-existing signal; consider a dedicated flag (e.g. api_key_keep=true) in the PUT payload to avoid subtle bugs if a user ever types six bullet characters.

sicon-mapping-conn badge just mirrors the last connectionStatus; when no test has been run it shows 'Not tested' which is fine, but it currently ignores the credentials_set state — could show 'Configured — not tested' vs 'Not configured' for clarity.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Master admin MFA is ON — pytest fixture pulls the TOTP secret from the user_mfa collection via utils.mfa.decrypt_secret and generates a code on the fly. The Sicon page is reachable at /master-admin?section=sicon-integration (NOT /master-admin/integrations/sicon which 404s, and NOT ?section=integrations which renders blank). Tabs on the Sicon page use data-testids sicon-tab-config / sicon-tab-mappings / sicon-tab-logs. Test Connection will always report unreachable in preview — that is the correct expected behaviour.
rca of the issue: N/A — all four bugs already fixed by E1. Backend correctly (a) preserves non-secret credential leaves and returns a credentials_set map (integrations.py:114), (b) merges masked '••••••' as keep-existing on PUT (integrations.py:161), (c) exposes /api/integrations/sicon/test-connection with descriptive error handling and logs (integrations.py:703), and (d) /api/sicon/field-mapping returns full 237-row grouped payload. Frontend IntegrationAdminPanel renders the saved-badge, API-key hint, Test Connection card + result banner, grouped Field Mappings tables, and an always-populated Event Log expand block.
